title: Skywork-Reward: Bag of Tricks for Reward Modeling in LLMs
authors_zh: Chris Yuhao Liu、Liang Zeng、Jiacai Liu、Rui Yan、Jujie He、Chaojie Wang、Shuicheng Yan、Yang Liu、Yahui Zhou
paper_type_zh: 后训练数据、偏好、奖励或评测研究

one_line: Skywork-Reward: Bag of Tricks for Reward Modeling in LLMs addresses practical reward-modeling methods.
发布 Skywork-Reward-Preference-80K，并总结数据选择、去噪和过滤等奖励模型训练配方。
why: It exposes a feedback, preference, reward, rubric, safety, or post-training data surface that must be audited before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Candidate paper on practical reward-modeling methods with an official arXiv primary link.

title: Problem
问题
html: Skywork-Reward frames reward modeling as a data-selection problem. Open preference collections can be large yet contain near duplicates, weak contrasts, inconsistent labels, or samples that teach an RM generator-specific style instead of preference. The paper asks whether a carefully selected and filtered set can train a stronger RM than a much larger indiscriminate mixture. Its central data object is not simply “80K pairs”; it is a curated subset whose inclusion rule is part of the algorithm.
Skywork‑Reward 把奖励建模表述为数据选择问题。开放偏好集可能很大，却含近重复、弱对照、不一致标签，或教会 RM 识别生成器特有文风而非偏好。论文追问：一个经过仔细选择和过滤的集合能否比大得多、无差别的混合训练出更强 RM？其中心数据对象不只是“80K 对”，而是一个纳入规则本身属于算法的策展子集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The reported recipe produces a Skywork-Reward collection of 80K preference pairs and trains Skywork-Reward-Gemma-27B and Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B. The paper’s bag of tricks is data-centric: it discusses selecting useful sources and filtering for quality. This means a pair’s provenance, quality signal, duplication status, and source distribution matter as much as its chosen/rejected fields. A reuse that copies only the final 80K rows but not the curation logic cannot test the paper’s main hypothesis.
报告配方得到 80K 对 Skywork‑Reward 偏好集合，并训练 Skywork‑Reward‑Gemma‑27B 与 Skywork‑Reward‑Llama‑3.1‑8B。论文的“技巧包”以数据为中心，讨论有用来源选择和质量过滤。这意味着一条回答对的来源、质量信号、去重状态和来源分布与优选/拒选字段同样重要。只复制最终 80K 行而不复制策展逻辑，无法检验论文的主要假设。

title: Method
方法
html: The training pipeline starts from open preference data, applies selection and filtering, then fits reward models on the resulting collection. A reproducible release must specify every upstream dataset revision, licensing constraint, normalization/format conversion, quality scorer or heuristic, threshold, deduplication rule, source mixture weight, and final item ID. It must also record base model, tokenizer/chat template, loss, batch/learning-rate schedule, sequence length, and checkpoint selection. Without this lineage, “Skywork-Reward data” is a label rather than a reproducible artifact.
训练流水线从开放偏好数据出发，应用选择与过滤，再在结果集合上拟合奖励模型。可复现发布必须说明每个上游数据版本、许可限制、归一化/格式转换、质量评分器或启发式、阈值、去重规则、来源混合权重和最终 item ID；还要记录基座、分词器/聊天模板、损失、batch/学习率计划、序列长度和检查点选择。没有这条血缘，“Skywork‑Reward 数据”只是标签而不是可复现工件。

title: Evidence
证据
html: At release, Skywork-Reward-Gemma-27B is reported at the top of the RewardBench leaderboard, and the authors report that their techniques directly enhance several highly ranked models. These are time-stamped benchmark claims. They demonstrate that a small selected collection can be competitive under the paper’s evaluation, but do not prove that every excluded example is harmful or that the same filters will help a different base model, language, or reward objective.
发布时，论文报告 Skywork‑Reward‑Gemma‑27B 位居 RewardBench 榜首，并称其技术直接提升了若干高排名模型。这些是带时间戳的基准主张，证明小型选定集合能在论文评测下竞争，却不证明每个被排除样本有害，也不证明同样过滤会帮助另一个基座、语言或奖励目标。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The direction signal is often summarized as “data is the algorithm” for reward modeling: quality and distribution can dominate raw pair count. Skywork-Reward differs from work that simply scales preference data because it treats filtering and mixture composition as first-class design choices. It does not introduce a novel reward loss, and it should not be interpreted as evidence that 80K is a universal optimum; the effective data size depends on task diversity, annotation quality, and model capacity.
方向信号常被概括为奖励建模中的“数据即算法”：质量和分布可以压过原始回答对数量。Skywork‑Reward 不同于仅扩大偏好数据的工作，因为它把过滤和混合组成作为一等设计选择。它没有提出新的奖励损失，也不能被理解为 80K 是普遍最优；有效数据量依赖任务多样性、标注质量和模型容量。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Curation can create new bias. A quality scorer can prefer the same response style as its teacher, deduplication can remove rare but valuable safety cases, and leaderboard-guided filtering can overfit RewardBench-like distributions. Selection may also reduce multilingual or domain diversity. Audit source-level retention rates, reward-margin distributions, length/style distributions, safety/refusal coverage, and performance on benchmarks that were not used to tune the recipe.
策展会产生新偏差。质量评分器可能偏好与其教师相同的回答风格，去重可能移除稀有但有价值的安全案例，面向排行榜的过滤可能过拟合 RewardBench 式分布；选择还可能降低多语种或领域多样性。应审计来源级保留率、奖励间隔、长度/文风分布、安全/拒答覆盖，以及未用于调配方的基准表现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Skywork-Reward for ablations about preference-data quality, to construct a transparent RM training mixture, or to test whether a compact data budget can outperform a larger baseline. It is useful when a team controls the data pipeline and can preserve provenance. It is not an excuse to discard raw data without documentation, and it does not replace independent evaluation of a reward model’s downstream optimization behavior.
Skywork‑Reward 适合研究偏好数据质量消融、构建透明 RM 训练混合，或测试紧凑数据预算能否胜过更大基线。当团队控制数据流水线且能保留来源时尤其有用。它不是在没有文档情况下丢弃原始数据的理由，也不替代对奖励模型下游优化行为的独立评测。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A serious experiment should compare at least three states: the raw source mixture, the filtered mixture at several thresholds, and the final 80K collection. Keep the exact row IDs for accepted and rejected examples, log every quality score, and freeze the reward benchmark version before selecting a checkpoint. Report the cost of curation as well as RM performance; an expensive hidden teacher or manual review changes the practical value of the recipe.
严肃实验至少应比较三种状态：原始来源混合、多个阈值下的过滤混合、最终 80K 集合。保存接受与拒绝样本的确切 row ID，记录全部质量分数，并在选择检查点前固定奖励基准版本。除 RM 表现外也应报告策展成本；昂贵的隐藏教师或人工复核会改变配方的实际价值。
